For your gluten-free bread recipe, the best alternative to all-purpose flour to maintain an airy structure is a high-quality **1:1 gluten-free baking flour blend** that contains xanthan gum or guar gum. These blends are specifically formulated to mimic the texture and binding properties of wheat flour, helping to trap air bubbles and prevent the loaf from becoming dense or crumbly. If your blend does not already contain a gum, adding 1/2 teaspoon of xanthan gum per cup of flour can also help improve the rise and texture.
